scope: LibreCAD refuse unqualified cross-version R13 raw record conversion before publication
finding: Generated in-memory R13 raw OBJECTS, ENTITIES and section carriers were each omitted during R14 export; before this guard the filter returned success and replaced an existing destination. A handle-matched typed candidate is not a source-field equivalence or graph-closure receipt.
change: Before invoking the writer, reject cross-version exports that contain any R13 raw object, entity or section, including those with a possible typed replacement. Report a specific reason and leave the destination untouched. This conservative gate applies only to R13 raw carriers with a different target version; it is not an R13 writer or graph-preserving implementation.

verification.red: Installed ABI-3 generated controls reproduced success, source-record omission and destination replacement for all three carrier kinds before the fix.
verification.green: On macOS ARM64 both installed ABI-3 and bundled codec builds pass the focused in-memory matrix: three carrier kinds, four target versions (R14/R2000/R2007/R2018), existing and absent destinations, same-filter clean retry and successful output (204 assertions). The exact locally authored and ODA-converted R13 ASCII/Binary pair is hash-bound below; installed and bundled r13-selected tests pass 230 and 246 assertions respectively and check specific R13 diagnostics, destination preservation and retry. LibreCAD output in this path is ASCII. No drawing fixtures were committed.
verification.broader_version_check: The installed-codec [filter][version] selector has 5 cases: 1 passed and 4 failed (9 failing assertions; dangling reference assertions in AC1015-AC1032 plus old-version and live-identity export failures). Rebuilding the unchanged candidate filter and rerunning reproduced the exact same 4 failing cases and 9 assertions. Bundled selector passed 8 cases / 118 assertions. These are open installed-codec compatibility defects, not evidence that the new R13 guard caused them.

limits: The fix is a fail-closed boundary, not preservation of the 65 omitted sample records or a fix for double-remapped MLINESTYLE ownership. Source payloads with UNKNOWNV or typed-only data are not covered by this R13-raw gate. Full graph closure, independent semantic readback, native UI and other platform qualification remain open. The local LibreCAD candidate and patch are unmerged and unpublished; apply with git apply --unidiff-zero after the prior ordered candidate patches.
